_README: POINT-IN-TIME SCHEDULE KNOWLEDGE for the 2025/26 replay.
`known_from` maps a gameweek that contains a double or a blank to the EARLIEST
gameweek by which that anomaly was publicly confirmed. The replay reads fixtures
from an end-of-season archive, so every rearrangement-created DGW/BGW is visible
from GW1 — see optimize.chip_timing.knowable_double_blank. Without this file the
chip advisor picks chip weeks on hindsight.
A gameweek NOT listed here is trusted only inside SCHEDULE_KNOWABLE_GWS (3) of the
current deadline. Add an entry only with a dated, pre-deadline source.
This is deliberately conservative: when the confirmation date is uncertain, the
LATER gameweek is recorded, because over-stating what we knew inflates the result.

provenance.26: Arsenal + Wolves double. Confirmed in the GW24 research sweep and recorded in plan.md's GW24 close as 'DGW26 CONFIRMED (Arsenal + Wolves)'; the GW26 researcher independently re-derived it from the pre-deadline schedule (Brentford v Arsenal 12 Feb, Wolves v Arsenal 18 Feb). Known from GW24.
provenance.31: Arsenal, Man City, Crystal Palace and Wolves blank. Recorded in plan.md at the GW24 close as 'BGW31 flagged (Free Hit/WC candidate)'. Known from GW24.
provenance.33: A Man City / Crystal Palace double created by rearranging the postponed MCI v CRY fixture. NOT knowable in February: the GW28 researcher found (FFScout, 25 Feb) that 'MCI v CRY is still unrescheduled' and a later City/Palace double was only 'seeded'; the GW29 researcher found the community's 'save the chip for the later double' argument is datable only to MID-MARCH, i.e. post-GW29. Recorded as known from GW30 — conservative, and later than any source we hold. [2026-07-28: superseded by the run-in research - see the GW32/33 consensus files for the dated confirmation of the six-team GW33 double and the GW34 blank it creates.]
provenance._no_other_entries: GW27-30, 32 and 34-38 carry no confirmed anomaly in our sourced research. If a future run needs one, add it WITH a dated source rather than inferring it from the archive.
provenance.36: Man City + Crystal Palace double, created by the rearranged MCI v CRY fixture. Confirmed for Wed 13 May on 28-29 Apr 2026: FFScout 'Double Gameweek 36 confirmed' (28 Apr); premierleague.com 4637635 / 4637009 and the PL 'Fixture Amendments 26' PDF (29 Apr). Before that the date was genuinely disputed - City contested the proposal and lost. The GW34 deadline was 24 Apr and GW35 was 1 May, so this became knowable only for GW35 onward: known_from 35. One unverified thread that could date it earlier (premierleague.com 4611210, a rolling article whose relevant sentence could not be dated) is deliberately NOT admitted - the conservative reading stands.
